name: rainshadow.places.search
description: Search the place gazetteer by name or region (case-insensitive substring). Returns each place with its time zone, alert zones and whether it is saved in this account. No side effects.

query.description: Text to find in a place name or region.

name: rainshadow.places.list
description: List the saved places of this account with their label, alert rule (categories, minimum severity, paused) and the number of open watches. No side effects.

name: rainshadow.sources.list
description: List forecast sources (weather or air quality). is_default marks the account's default weather source and its default air-quality source. No side effects.

name: rainshadow.forecast.issuances
description: List the forecast issuances stored for a place, newest first. Each issuance is one source's forecast at one issue time. id is the place ID. No side effects.

cursor.description: Opaque value from next_cursor of the previous page.

name: rainshadow.forecast.hourly
description: Read hourly forecast rows for a place and window from one issuance. By default this is the latest issuance of the account default source; issuance_id returns an earlier one. The result always names the issuance (id, issued_at, is_latest). Rows are returned as issued, in the account units; coverage.missing lists requested hours the issuance does not contain. Rainshadow never interpolates and never falls back to another source. id is the place ID. No side effects.

start.description: Window start, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

end.description: Window end (exclusive), ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

source_id.description: Weather source; defaults to the account default source.

issuance_id.description: A specific issuance for this place instead of the latest.

cursor.description: Opaque value from next_cursor of the previous page.

name: rainshadow.forecast.daily
description: Read daily forecast rows for a place from one issuance: headline, summary, high, low and day and night precipitation probability for a weather source, or the air-quality index and its category for an air-quality source. The headline describes the whole day exactly as issued. The window selects the local dates it touches. id is the place ID. No side effects.

start.description: Window start, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

end.description: Window end (exclusive), ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

source_id.description: Weather or air-quality source; defaults to the account's default weather source.

issuance_id.description: A specific issuance for this place instead of the latest.

name: rainshadow.conditions.get
description: Read the newest observation for a place and its age in minutes. observation is null when the place has none. id is the place ID. No side effects.

name: rainshadow.alerts.list
description: List the alerts that affect a place (they share an alert zone) and overlap the window. Cancelled and expired alerts are hidden unless include_closed is true. Status is upcoming before onset, active until ends, then expired; cancelled after a cancel message. id is the place ID. No side effects.

start.description: Window start, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

end.description: Window end (exclusive), ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

name: rainshadow.alerts.get
description: Read one alert thread: every message in order (alert, update, cancel), its current status, the acknowledgement history and the places it affects. id is the alert ID. No side effects.

name: rainshadow.watches.list
description: List the weather watches of this account with their current status and latest evaluation. A watch reads ended once its window end has passed. Ended and cancelled watches are hidden unless include_closed is true. No side effects.

name: rainshadow.watches.get
description: Read one watch: place, window, weather source, air-quality source (when it has an aqi condition), conditions, status and the evaluation record, which names every issuance used, the hours and dates covered or missed and what met each condition. id is the watch ID. No side effects.

name: rainshadow.notices.list
description: List the notices Rainshadow wrote for this account, newest first: alert notices for saved places and watch notices. Every notice has a release time: the time it was written, or the end of the quiet period it was written in. It reads held before that time and released from then on. No side effects.

since.description: Only notices created at or after this time.

cursor.description: Opaque value from next_cursor of the previous page.

name: rainshadow.preferences.get
description: Read the account preferences: units, default weather source, default air-quality source (null when none is set), home time zone, quiet hours and whether notices are also emailed. No side effects.

name: rainshadow.places.save
description: Save a gazetteer place in this account under a label of the user's own, with an alert rule: which alert categories and minimum severity produce a notice for this place, and whether the rule is paused. id is the place ID. Errors: not_found, already_saved.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result.

name: rainshadow.places.update
description: Change the label or alert rule of a saved place. Only the fields present in patch change. id is the place ID. Errors: not_found.

id.description: Place ID of a saved place.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result.

name: rainshadow.places.remove
description: Remove a saved place and its alert rule. A place that an open watch still uses cannot be removed. id is the place ID. Errors: not_found, place_in_use.

id.description: Place ID of a saved place.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result.

name: rainshadow.preferences.update
description: Change account preferences. Only the fields present in patch change. Units change how values are returned, not what is stored. Quiet hours hold new notices until they end, except notices for extreme alerts; notices already written keep their release time. default_air_source_id is the air-quality source new watches use for aqi conditions; null clears it. Errors: not_found (an unknown default source, or one of the wrong kind), invalid_timezone, invalid_window (quiet hours that start and end at the same time).

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/Denver.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result.

name: rainshadow.alerts.acknowledge
description: Acknowledge the latest message of an upcoming or active alert on behalf of the user. An update clears the acknowledgement. id is the alert ID. Errors: not_found, stale_message (message_id is not the latest message), already_acknowledged, invalid_state (the alert is cancelled or expired).

message_id.description: The message that was read; it must be the latest one.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result.

name: rainshadow.watches.create
description: Create a weather watch on a saved place: a time window, a weather source, an air-quality source when it has an aqi condition, and one to six alternative conditions. Rainshadow evaluates it at once (status no_data, clear or triggered) and again whenever a new issuance from one of its sources or an alert message arrives, and writes a notice when it becomes triggered or goes from triggered to clear. The watch ends when its window ends. id is the place ID; the result id is the new watch ID. Errors: not_found (the place is not saved, a source is unknown or of the wrong kind, or an aqi condition has no air-quality source to use), invalid_window (window already over, longer than 10 days, or start not before end), limit_exceeded (more than 20 open watches), invalid_arguments (aq_source_id without an aqi condition).

id.description: Place ID of a saved place.

start.description: Window start, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

end.description: Window end (exclusive), ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

conditions.description: One to six alternative conditions; one met condition in one hour is enough. Threshold: {variable, op (gte default, or lte), value, unit}. variable is pop or thunder_prob (%), precip (mm or in per hour), wind_gust or wind_speed (km/h or mph), temp or apparent_temp (C or F), or aqi (index, daily). unit defaults to the account units. Alert: {variable: "alert", category (default any), min_severity (default minor)} is met by an upcoming or active alert that affects the place and overlaps the window.

source_id.description: Weather source to follow; defaults to the account default source.

aq_source_id.description: Air-quality source for aqi conditions; defaults to the account's default air-quality source. Only for a watch with an aqi condition.

linked_object.description: Optional opaque reference supplied by the caller, for example a Calendar event. Rainshadow never reads it.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result.

name: rainshadow.watches.update
description: Change an open watch. Only the fields present in patch change. The watch is evaluated again and no notice is written, because the user caused the change. A watch that loses its last aqi condition drops its air-quality source. id is the watch ID. Errors: not_found, invalid_state (the watch is ended or cancelled), invalid_window, invalid_arguments (an empty patch, or aq_source_id without an aqi condition).

start.description: Window start, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

end.description: Window end (exclusive), ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

conditions.description: One to six alternative conditions; one met condition in one hour is enough. Threshold: {variable, op (gte default, or lte), value, unit}. variable is pop or thunder_prob (%), precip (mm or in per hour), wind_gust or wind_speed (km/h or mph), temp or apparent_temp (C or F), or aqi (index, daily). unit defaults to the account units. Alert: {variable: "alert", category (default any), min_severity (default minor)} is met by an upcoming or active alert that affects the place and overlaps the window.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result.

name: rainshadow.watches.cancel
description: Cancel an open watch. It keeps its history and writes no further notices. id is the watch ID. Errors: not_found, invalid_state (already ended or cancelled).

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result.
